{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' from string to float, handling possible non-numeric values
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Filter for completed orders from LOYAL customers
loyal_completed = sales_df[(sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (sales_df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Print the number of such orders
print(len(loyal_completed))

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue'].mean()
print(mean_revenue)"}
